name: Caterpillar D7 3T Tractor
blurb: A Hangar-only wartime crawler tractor with moving tracks and a reviewable raised and tilted dozer blade.
history: D7 tractors were essential engineering machines for road and airfield construction. The War Department maintenance manual establishes the wartime tractor family; this model's blade arrangement and displayed envelope are conservative estimates.

sources.title: TM 9-1773C1: Ordnance Maintenance, Caterpillar Diesel Engines and Tractors
